title: The $113 Million Decision: How Brunson's Sacrifice Built a Championship Dynasty
description:
How did Jalen Brunson's historic $113 million contract discount in 2024 directly lead to the New York Knicks' 2026 NBA championship? This deep-dive documentary episode examines the most selfless financial decision in modern sports history and its stunning payoff.

From the shocking July 2024 extension announcement to the confetti raining in San Antonio after Game 5, we trace the complete story of a sacrifice that changed franchise history. We break down the CBA apron rules that made Brunson's decision necessary, the Karl-Anthony Towns trade it enabled, and the championship run it produced.

We also explore the ripple effects across the roster and the league, the pressure Brunson faced all season, and the massive payday waiting for him in 2028. Plus: what the 1973 championship team would think of this squad, and whether the Knicks can defend their title.

A story about trust, belief, and the courage to bet on yourself and your teammates.
